headlines.title: Baltic dry bulk freight index hits six-week low
headlines.content_summary: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index dropped to its lowest point in six weeks on Tuesday, pulled down by declining capesize rates. The main Baltic index, which monitors rates for capesize, panamax and supramax vessels, fell 68 points, or 2.2%, to 3,002 points. This marks the index’s weakest level since August 25.
